subject: [PATCH 25/46] mm/userfaultfd: wake waiters when registration modes are removed

reviews.author: Lorenzo (ARM)
reviews.summary:
Reviewer Lorenzo (ARM) suggested that instead of reverting to the legacy API, the patch should use the correct API and provide a separate predicate to handle older versions.

The reviewer pointed out that the patch does not correctly handle mode changes in userfaultfd_register_range(), specifically when changing from MISSING|WP to WP, which leaves missing tracking enabled and bypasses the new wake mechanism.
reviews.raw_body:
Would be better not to regress to the legacy API. I realise we don't use it for
backported fixes in general, but this patch obviously won't apply to older
versions anyway, so we should use the correct API now, and this for older
versions.

I'll add a better predicate probably to do this in one go, but for the fix,
I put the correct patch below.

---

diff --git a/mm/userfaultfd.c b/mm/userfaultfd.c
index 777bf122d32a..c71cb9179913 100644
--- a/mm/userfaultfd.c
+++ b/mm/userfaultfd.c
@@ -2288,6 +2288,9 @@ static int userfaultfd_register_range(struct userfaultfd_ctx *ctx,
 		prev = vma;

 	for_each_vma_range(vmi, vma, end) {
+		const vma_flags_t curr_vma_flags =
+			vma_flags_and_mask(&vma->flags, __VMA_UFFD_FLAGS);
+
 		cond_resched();

 		VM_WARN_ON_ONCE(!vma_can_userfault(vma, vm_flags, wp_async));
@@ -2300,7 +2303,7 @@ static int userfaultfd_register_range(struct userfaultfd_ctx *ctx,
 		 * userfaultfd and with the right tracking mode too.
 		 */
 		if (vma->vm_userfaultfd_ctx.ctx == ctx &&
-		    vma_test_all_mask(vma, vma_flags))
+		    vma_flags_same_pair(&curr_vma_flags, &vma_flags))
 			goto skip;

 		/*

--
Cheers, Lorenzo

reviews.author: David (Arm)
reviews.summary: Reviewer David (Arm) noted that the patch does not handle the case where registration modes are removed, and suggested adding a check to ensure that the current and requested UFFD modes match exactly before skipping the update.
reviews.raw_body:
From: Gregory Price <gourry@gourry.net>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 20:27:52 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] mm/userfaultfd: compare exact registration modes before
 skipping

Changing registration from MISSING|WP to WP returns success but leaves
MISSING enabled. The no-op check sees that WP is already set and skips
the update, so later accesses to missing pages still wait for userspace.

Skip the update only when the current and requested UFFD modes match
exactly.

Fixes: 63b2d4174c4a ("userfaultfd: wp: add the writeprotect API to userfaultfd ioctl")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Gregory Price (Meta) <gourry@gourry.net>
[ david: apply fixup from Lorenzo ]
Signed-off-by: David Hildenbrand (Arm) <david@kernel.org>
---
 mm/userfaultfd.c | 3 ++-
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/mm/userfaultfd.c b/mm/userfaultfd.c
index 710e913c73bf..24b7a2612469 100644
--- a/mm/userfaultfd.c
+++ b/mm/userfaultfd.c
@@ -2291,6 +2291,7 @@ static int userfaultfd_register_range(struct userfaultfd_ctx *ctx,
 
 	for_each_vma_range(vmi, vma, end) {
 		const bool any_mode_removed = vma->vm_flags & __VM_UFFD_FLAGS & ~vm_flags;
+		const vma_flags_t curr_vma_flags = vma_flags_and_mask(&vma->flags, __VMA_UFFD_FLAGS);
 
 		cond_resched();
 
@@ -2304,7 +2305,7 @@ static int userfaultfd_register_range(struct userfaultfd_ctx *ctx,
 		 * userfaultfd and with the right tracking mode too.
 		 */
 		if (vma->vm_userfaultfd_ctx.ctx == ctx &&
-		    vma_test_all_mask(vma, vma_flags))
+		    vma_flags_same_pair(&curr_vma_flags, &vma_flags))
 			goto skip;
 
 		/*
-- 
2.43.0


-- 
Cheers,

David

2026-10-27.patch_summary: This patch fixes an issue where the userfaultfd registration mode is not properly updated when changing from MISSING|WP to WP, leading to missing pages still waiting for userspace access. The problem arises because the current no-op check only compares the presence of specific flags and does not require exact mode matches. To fix this, the patch changes the comparison logic in userfaultfd_register_range() to ensure that the current and requested UFFD modes match exactly before skipping the update. This change is necessary to prevent writers from timing out due to missing faults.
